articles.summary: Brazil's Central Bank just updated rules for eFX international payments. Here's a clear breakdown of Resolution 561, what it actually prohibits, and why BlindPay's stablecoin + local rails model continues to deliver faster, cheaper, and fully compliant cross-border payments for businesses.
articles.title: BCB Resolution 561: New eFX Rules for Stablecoins in Brazil and Why BlindPay Is Unaffected
